# Options

Accepted by every command. Options that belong to a single command are listed
with [that command](commands.qmd).

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--out DIR` | where to save media. Default `./ig_archiver` in the current directory; each account gets its own subfolder |
| `--browser-profile DIR` | persistent browser profile directory. Default is a per-user application data directory |
| `--headless` | run without a window. Only after `login` has succeeded once |
| `--videos` | also download videos. Off by default, so a photo archive stays a photo archive; a skipped video leaves a placeholder |
| `--skip-reels` | leave out posts the profile links as reels. They are ordinary posts of the account's own, so leaving them out loses content |
| `--comments` | also record each post's comments - username, time and text. Off by default |
| `--resume` | skip posts the index shows are already complete, instead of visiting each one to find out |
| `--force` | ignore the index and fetch everything again, overwriting what is on disk. Use after changing *what* gets saved |
| `--nested` | give each post its own folder. The default is flat: every file sits in the account folder, named `<date>_<postid>_NN` |
| `--log FILE` | where to write the run log. Default `archive.log` beside the media; pass `-` to write no log |
| `--version` | print the version |
| `--help` | show help, on the tool or on any command |

## The defaults, and why

**Photos, not videos.** A photo archive that quietly grows to 50 GB of video
is a surprise. Ask for videos with `--videos`; what was skipped is recorded,
and [`fill-videos`](commands.qmd#fill-videos) fetches it later without walking
the profile again.

**Reels included.** They are posts the account made, in the same grid as the
rest. Leaving them out loses content, so `--skip-reels` is the opt-out rather
than the default.

**Flat, not nested.** Every file sits in the account folder named
`<date>_<postid>_NN`, which sorts chronologically anywhere. `--nested` gives
each post its own folder, and [`relayout`](commands.qmd#relayout) converts an
existing archive either way without re-downloading.

**No comments.** Comments are other people's words about someone's post, so
collecting them should be a choice rather than a side effect of archiving your
own photographs.

## Where the session lives

`login` saves the browser session here, and `--browser-profile` overrides it.
To switch Instagram accounts, delete this directory and run `login` again.

| Platform | Session directory |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\instagram-archiver\browser_profile` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/instagram-archiver/browser_profile` |
| Linux | `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/instagram-archiver/browser_profile` |
